findings.reason: the node would regenerate a record that cannot satisfy its own done-when, and the missing action (adding the sixth plan to the producer's plan list and arm pattern) is a one-line plan edit now versus a failed gate later.
findings.text: s8's done-when requires the pooled table "over all 18 replayed sections", but its negative control requires a replayed section whose plan the producer does not name to be "listed as excluded with its reason rather than dropped, as it dropped land s10 before this section". The committed producer's plan list (`PLAN_ABBREV`) and its arm-name pattern name only five plans, so `a-landing-never-waits-on-a-shared-index#s10` — one of the 18 replayed sections in `paired-replay-assignment-2.json` — is skipped outright at `paired_replay_report.py:466-467`; extending the producer "to read both assignments" does not name that plan, so either the table holds 17 rows (failing "all 18") or s10 is put in the exclusions (failing the pooled count), and the two clauses cannot both hold

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every path s18 names resolves (`reckon/anchored_edit.py`, `reckon/schema/flight.yaml`, `reckon/_flight_schema.py`, `docs/_shared/flight.schema.json`, `reckon/_backends.py`, `reckon/_worker_fence.py`, `reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py`, `reckon/crew/prompts.py`, `reckon/capabilities.py`, `reckon/crew/dispatch.py`, `reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py`, `reckon/crew/dispatching/`, the three deleted test files and the four test files that must stop naming the key — those seven are exactly the files under `tests/` that currently name `anchored_edit`), and s8's producer and archive path both exist.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — s8's done-when demands a pooled table "over all 18 replayed sections" while its own negative control requires land s10 (the one replayed section whose plan the committed producer does not name) to be listed as excluded, and nothing states the change that would make s10 poolable.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — s8's record lands at `docs/evidence/archive/workers-spend-fewer-tokens-per-landed-node-landed.html` (exists) with the producer beside it under `docs/evidence/fragments/...`, and both sections put gate logs under the run directory, not a scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — s18 removes symbols and keys rather than introducing any; no plan label, stage name or ticket number is carried into code, and the arm names it deletes are described by what they are.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — s18's figures match s8's decision (21% to 4% edit failures, about 7% more input than clive) and its factual claim that the anchored flight backends are already gone resolves against the host flight; the endpoint is checkable, with the one population defect reported under done_when. No implementation is prescribed beyond the file list a removal necessarily names.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s8 now delivers only the pooled record and hands the removal to §18; s18 carries the anchored tool's removal alone.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s18 is declared implementable in `plan-section-declarations`; every section it deletes code from (s3, s4, s5, s10, s11) is `done`, so no `plan-section-depends-on` gate is needed, and s8's declared waits (s4, s5, s7, s10, s14, s17) still hold it until the replay population exists.
